title: Solabia steps up its transformation with the acquisition of Ethical Naturals
summary: The specialist in natural and biotechnological active ingredients is pursuing its strategic refocusing on cosmetics and nutraceuticals. Solabia plans to divest its microbiological diagnostics division while acquiring a majority stake in US-based Ethical Naturals Inc. Solabia is sharpening its strategic focus on cosmetics, nutrition, and life sciences. title: Gattefossé's Protecticire MB, natural waxes for the protection of hair fibers
summary: With Protecticire MB, Gattefossé introduces a 100% naturally derived active texturizing ingredient designed to help maintain hair quality over time. According to Gattefossé, Protecticire MB helps reduce breakage and split ends, protect color, and enhance softness, shine and lightness across a wide range of haircare applications. title: Seppic triples natural extract production capacity at its Lons site in France
summary: The specialty ingredients manufacturer inaugurated a new production unit at its Lons site, near Pau, France, in late October 2026. With this investment, Seppic aims to meet the growing global demand for purified natural active ingredients. Seppic's Lons site covers 8 hectares and employs more than 50 people. The new 1,400 m² building will enable the company to triple production capacity for its Ceramosides range, which targets both the beauty and nutrition markets.
